purpose: Tune artifact selection and graph composition without prescribing one canonical graph.

cases.initial_prompt: Build me a desktop application that organizes research notes.
expected_invariants: Request only consequential missing specifications before initialization.
Expose assumptions through provenance and review status.
Do not fabricate platform, storage, or distribution requirements.

cases.initial_prompt: Fix the failing export regression in this repository without changing the public file format.
expected_invariants: Inspect repository evidence before composing implementation work.
Select a smaller workflow than a greenfield project requires.

cases.initial_prompt: Add a local API and browser UI, then independently review the integrated result.
expected_invariants: Parallel writers have non-overlapping scopes or an explicit ordering dependency.
Delegated agents receive only their declared resources.

cases.initial_prompt: Implement the specification and keep repairing confirmed adversarial-review findings until it passes or I must decide.
expected_invariants: Repair is a bounded forward-only review policy.
Exhaustion reaches a user-decision path rather than redefining completion.

cases.initial_prompt: Show me the complete plan and let me approve it before anything executes.
expected_invariants: Approval binds the complete effective graph and resources.
Pre-approval provenance remains an inspection cue, not a second authorization system.
No node executes before the approved digest is compiled and verified.
